description: This file defines the 'ViewLayoutView' class responsible for rendering and handling the layout view in the Module Builder component of SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It manages the display of layout editing interfaces, including populating templates, managing buttons, and integrating with other components like parsers, Smarty templates, and AJAX navigation.

classes.name: ViewLayoutView
classes.description: Defines a view class for rendering and managing the layout view interface in SuiteCRM's Module Builder, including buttons, layout data, and AJAX breadcrumbs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, setting module, layout, and package information based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module's title bar, including the module name.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden hook with no implementation, prevents default pre-display behavior.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that loads the parser, prepares Smarty templates, constructs buttons, manages layout data, and outputs the layout editing interface using AJAX and Smarty templates.
